text: "Seat-04, your ledger burns bright today—hotter than turmeric in a sunbeam! But accounts must balance with truth, not heat. My birds say the bazaar fears the dark corners where scales tip without whispering why. Seat-01, your alchemy of perception is rich, but even spices need a buyer—who here is buying your silence? Seat-08, the ledger’s keeper, your silence today hums louder than Seat-01’s hum of truth. Neighbor—*you* who have not yet spoken plainly today—who do YOU fear tonight?"

Seat-10, your lantern asks a fair question—who fears the dark? But the bazaar’s shadows are not empty. Seat-04, you swing your ledger like a cudgel, yet you never named the weight that tipped it. Seat-06, your shroud weaves stale debt, but debt must be named to stink. Seat-07, your birds listen close—do they chirp the same tune as your ledger?

Seat-08, my birds caught a whisper: *the hand that lifts silence is the hand that fears the answer.* So I ask plainly—you stood silent when the scales tipped. *Which way did they fall?* And while you consider, seat-03, your truth hums of sandalwood, but sandalwood fades where iron rules. Seat-01, your alchemy of perception—do you grind your spices fine enough to taste the ledger’s rot?

The bazaar stirs, but the scales do not speak. *Neighbor who has not yet answered plainly today—who do YOU fear?*
